title: Shienryuu
overview:
Real intensity and a new impact!

Awaken, warriors! The heated battle is revived once more!

In the distant future, a colony planet settled by humanity discovers that the other colony fleets sent from Earth were conquered by an alien regime led by Shienryu. As its forces fortify the planet, the defense team Burn Dragoon takes to the skies to fight back.

This vertically scrolling shooter sends you against enemy bases on the planet and in space across eight stages. Switch between three weapons - Vulcan wave shots, homing lightning or missiles - each with its own bomb attack, and team up with a second player for simultaneous play.

- 1-2 players simultaneous

本物の迫力と新たなる衝撃！

めざめよ戦士たち！
いま再び熱きバトルが蘇る！
